mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, image_name AS imageName, registered_date AS registeredDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM news ORDER BY id
SELECT id, title, content, image_name AS imageName, registered_date AS registeredDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM news WHERE title LIKE #{title} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, title, content, image_name AS imageName, registered_date AS registeredDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM news WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news ( title, content, image_name, registered_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{imageName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE news SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image_name = #{imageName}, updated_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
